Free pilot

The pilot is free and has no payment commitment. [[FILL: pilot length, e.g. "It runs for up to 4 weeks."]]

You can stop the pilot at any time by contacting us. No payment is involved, so there is nothing to refund.

Paid plans

[[FILL: describe paid plans, whether they are monthly or annual, and whether they are refundable. E.g. "Paid plans are billed monthly. You may cancel at any time and your service continues until the end of the paid period."]]

Refund window: [[FILL: e.g. "If you cancel within 7 days of a payment, we will refund the full amount. After 7 days, we do not offer partial refunds, but your service continues until the end of the billing period."]]

How to cancel

To cancel your plan or stop the pilot:

  • Contact us through the website.
  • WhatsApp us at +919876543210.
  • Email hello@stamp.example.com.

We will confirm the cancellation within one working day.

Refund process

If you are eligible for a refund:

  1. Contact us with your shop name and the payment you want refunded.
  2. We will verify and process the refund within [[FILL: e.g. "5 working days"]].
  3. The refund goes back to your original payment method. Bank processing may take an additional [[FILL: e.g. "5–7 working days"]].

GST invoices

We provide GST invoices for all paid plans. Invoices are sent to your registered email after each payment. If you need a corrected invoice, contact us.
